text: I’m very sad to hear of your family’s experience. Seems like there is too much randomness and uncertainty regarding family visits and ultimately it is entirely up to the customs officer, which is a very frustrating situation. When we had the interview at MH we specifically asked whether we need to formally invite my wife’s family if they want to come visit but the clerk said “I don’t think there’s a need for that”. Now this makes me question what she said…
